stops.name: Walenstadt
stops.quote: Das Ortsmuseum widmet sich der Geschichte von Walenstadt.
stops.english: The local museum is dedicated to the history of Walenstadt.

stops.name: Walenpfad
stops.quote: Here is a chance for unique mountain adventures and mountain railway experiences - the Walen Trail is a sophisticated pleasure tour with panoramic views.
stops.english: Here is a chance for unique mountain adventures and mountain railway experiences - the Walen Trail is a sophisticated pleasure tour with panoramic views.

stops.name: Walensee Bike
stops.quote: A bike tour for aficionados on the south side of Lake Walen, with the most magnificent views of the fjord-like lake and the commanding Churfirsten Mountains, which tower steeply on the other side of the lake.
stops.english: A bike tour for aficionados on the south side of Lake Walen, with the most magnificent views of the fjord-like lake and the commanding Churfirsten Mountains, which tower steeply on the other side of the lake.

stops.name: Churfirsten
stops.quote: Experience Lake Walensee with the Churfirsten, the top excursion destination Quinten, the Seerenbach Falls and the leisure destinations Flumserberg and Amden.
